title: Exponent's scientific output over six decades
what: Peer-reviewed papers published by Exponent scientists each year (including under the firm's pre-1998 name, Failure Analysis Associates), from OpenAlex - a free, open index of the world's research literature.
how: OpenAlex records the employer listed on every scientific paper. We pulled every publication (about 5,000) whose author list includes an Exponent affiliation.
thesis: You can't charge $600/hour for an expert the other side can discredit. A consultancy whose staff keep publishing real science in real journals is maintaining the credential moat that justifies premium billing rates. Steady output = the moat is being maintained; a collapse would be an early warning.
caveats: Papers appear 1-2 years after the work behind them, and the most recent year is always undercounted while indexing catches up.
Publication volume says nothing about consulting revenue - it's a quality-of-franchise indicator.
